text: nice can u throw together a quick html file to show what you plan to do for a wiki layout so we are on the same page before we go in
resolution: Created a self-contained interactive HTML layout mock for the wiki-first World Bible inside the current Shitty Games editor chrome. It demonstrates two-pane wiki navigation, search and linked entity pages; standard page infoboxes and backlinks; partial entities and intentional absence of automatic platform presences; Read/Edit modes; visible disk-versus-draft ownership; semantic and exact-text review; and a simulated formal Write to Disk confirmation. The file uses no external assets or dependencies and can be opened directly in a browser.
